grid.provenance: Letter-column grid, numbers along diagonals [2.14: 'letters read horizontally... numbers read diagonally along the hexgrain; Damascus Gate W36, Yafo Gate P51, Susa Gate QQ36, Mariam Tower P55']. Engine col = letter index (A=1..Z=26, AA=27..), engine row = N + col//2. Geometry fitted on the 3,251-region RegionGrid of module v2.3 (same 4051x5656 map art as v3.0): 3,071/3,096 parseable region names reproduce EXACTLY through pixel_to_hex+display_name (the 25 misses are module typos, listed in ingest/INGEST_NOTES.md); landmarks W36/P51/G39 verified against map art; ~40 landmark markers byte-decoded from the module's Gallus .vsav all compute to their own printed hex. See ingest/ + validate_grid.py.

guide.victory: Assault of Gallus: the Romans win by controlling ten Built-up hexes at the end of any Judaean Melee Phase (control = last occupant [18.3]); the Judaeans win by preventing that through the end of turn 10. The engine tracks hex control and the Built-up count live.

stats.note: SoJ stats live in unit_types (fresh/disrupted sides, rally, missile ranges); the generic (att,def,ma) triple does not fit this system.

unit_types._cite: [2.41-2.46] unit diagrams pp.4-5, re-read at 260 dpi 2026-08-07; Gallus reverse from module counter art (Gallus_Reverse.gif). melee/ma = [fresh, disrupted]; missile = {range_band: AF} from the Weapons Effect Chart (game card); rock = AF at range 1 from Elevated only [2.523, 10.2].

zoc.note: SoJ ZOC (ground/gate/elevated, hard vs soft, night-off) is family-owned in engine/soj.py - the generic flags cannot express it

movement.note: Generic block covers ROMAN INFANTRY ground movement only (TEC: Clear 1 / Slope 3 / Built-up 3; Judaeans pay 2 in Built-up [8.95]); wall-class hexes are 99 here because entry is staircase/gate/breach-governed [8.91-8.93] - engine/soj.py owns the real per-class TEC below.

tec._cite: Terrain Effects Chart (module TEC.jpg, fully legible) + notes; costs per class [Infantry / Artillery / Cavalry / Tower / Ram / Testudo]; X = prohibited; fractions retained and cumulative [2.7]

breach._note: B = only if adjacent to another connecting Breach of the same wall [8.96]

wall_bastion_fortress._note: C = 1/2 MF from connected Elevated (1 MF if breach damage >= half defense [12.4]); S = 2 MF level change via Staircase hexside or Breach [8.93]

source_defects.note: Defects in the ORIGINAL PUBLISHED GAME found during encoding - spec #21. Authority ladder: official errata > tournament/publisher clarification > proven outcome-equivalence > declared umpired.

list.defect: The printed map gives hex QQ32 blue (Bastion) hexsides; the rulebook's own errata paragraph corrects it: 'The hexsides of QQ32 should be orange (fort); not blue (bastion).'
list.resolution: QQ32 is encoded as a Fort (breach defense 12, Fort missile row). The v3.0.0 module map art already paints QQ32 orange - the module author pre-applied the official errata.
list.authority: Official errata printed in the rulebook [2.15].

list.defect: The two official Q&A documents answer the SAME question oppositely. The General's Question Box: 'Can/must Judaean units leave a ground-level Heavy Infantry ZOC when routing/panicking? A. Yes.' The later AH Q&A typescript (dated Monday, January 6, 1992): identical question, 'A. No.'
list.resolution: The later ruling is enforced: Judaean units in Roman Heavy-Infantry ground-level ZOC do NOT move when Routed/Panicked (they remain in place, consistent with the 7.311 freeze). Both rulings quoted in the validation library.
list.authority: Official Q&A, later document supersedes earlier (1/6/1992 typescript over the Question Box printing).

list.defect: The reinforcement rule says the Judaean player 'rolls the dice' (plural) for how many Giora units enter, then 'rolls the die again' (singular) for the entry gate - whether the count roll is one die or two is not defined anywhere in the rules or either official Q&A document.
list.resolution: Encoded as TWO dice for the count (the game's standard is two d6 [2. COMPONENTS: 'two six-sided dice'; Repair and Elevated Hex Damage rolls are explicitly 'two dice']) and one die for the gate, following the card's own singular/plural distinction. Flagged for module-author/expert review.
list.authority: Declared interpretation from the card's wording; expert review pending (no official ruling found).

list.defect: The Assault Period Interphase sequence printed in The General Vol 26 No 4 is wrong per the corrected sequence-of-play aid reviewed by developer Don Greenwood (Sinigaglio prep+interphase aid).
list.resolution: Campaign-game scope - not reachable from the Gallus scenario. To be registered in full when the campaign game is encoded; the corrected Greenwood-reviewed sequence is preserved in the validation library (atf_interphase.htm).
list.authority: Developer-reviewed correction (semi-official), pending full campaign encoding.
